title: Knowledge-sync DAG template
objective: After final verification, draft and apply stable testing knowledge: acceptance verdict, cases, coverage, defects, requirement delta pointers, and run audit records under features/*/testing/**.
successCriteria: knowledge-sync-collect-pi inventories final verification evidence, ACs, cases, and defect candidates without writing files
knowledge-sync-validate-shell fails closed on missing draft, invalid schema, or non-pass finalVerification when gated
multi-perspective review (qa/domain/evidence) each emit VERDICT; aggregate gate requires all pass before apply
knowledge-sync-apply-pi upserts acceptance-verdict, coverage-matrix, cases, automation-map, and defects only within writeSet
knowledge-sync-pointer-pi writes runs/latest.md and sync/applied/KS-*.json audit pointers
No writes to src/**, .harness/**, or knowledge/testing/standards/**
globalConstraints: Replace feature-id placeholders with the concrete Feature id before production runs.
Do not commit runtime traces under .harness/dag-runs/.
Use only existing executors: pi, shell. Pi writer nodes must set toolProfile=write.
Read-only nodes must not write repository files.
Exclusive writer nodes must stay within declared writeSet.
Final verification shell evidence remains completion authority; knowledge-sync stores stable facts and path pointers only.
High-risk requirement/acceptance body changes require human approval via requirement-delta; do not silently rewrite requirement.md.
Prefer structured YAML/Markdown L1 knowledge pack over vector-store-only writes.

tasks.outputContract: Plain Markdown inventory of evidence and knowledge-sync candidates; no file writes.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Collect final-verification evidence, AC list, cases, defects, and requirement-delta candidates. Read-only.
Write schemaVersion 1 draft with operations, payload, and gates. Stay within writeSet.

tasks.outputContract: Deterministic draft schema validation; exit non-zero on invalid draft.

commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function walk(d,a=[]){if(!fs.existsSync(d))return a;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p,a);else if(e.name==='knowledge-sync-draft.json')a.push(p);}return a;}const drafts=walk('features');if(!drafts.length){console.error('no draft');process.exit(1);}for(const f of drafts){const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));if(d.schemaVersion!==1)process.exit(1);}console.log('ok');"

tasks.outputContract: Applied L1 knowledge files: acceptance-verdict, coverage-matrix, cases, defects, optional requirement-delta.
tasks.subtask_prompt: Apply validated draft into Feature testing knowledge paths. Do not touch standards or src.
Write run pointers and applied audit record only.
